  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},

\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
  \node at (-0.9,0) {$1\;+$};

  \node at (2.0,0) {$+$};
  \node at (2.6,-1.95) {};

  % dumbbell
  \begin{scope}[xshift=3.4cm]
    \draw[fdl] (0,0) to[bend left=35] (1.3,0); \draw[fdl] (0,0) to[bend right=35] (1.3,0);
    \draw[fdl] (-0.35,0) circle (0.35); \draw[fdl] (1.65,0) circle (0.35);
    \node[fdv] at (0,0){}; \node[fdv] at (1.3,0){};
    \node[fdlab] at (0.12,-0.62){$z_1$}; \node[fdlab] at (1.18,-0.62){$z_2$}; \draw[gray, line width=0.3pt] (0.1,-0.5)--(0.02,-0.08); \draw[gray, line width=0.3pt] (1.2,-0.5)--(1.28,-0.08);
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0.65,-1.55) {dumbbell\\[1pt] $\frac1{16}$, $S=16$\\[1pt] $72$ of $1152$};
  \end{scope}
  \node at (6.05,0) {$+$};
  % melon
  \begin{scope}[xshift=7.0cm]
    \foreach \b in {70,22,-22,-70}{\draw[fdl] (0,0) to[bend left=\b] (1.6,0);}
    \node[fdv] at (0,0){}; \node[fdv] at (1.6,0){};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (-0.08,0){$z_1$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.68,0){$z_2$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0.8,-1.55) {melon\\[1pt] $\frac1{48}$, $S=48$\\[1pt] $24$ of $1152$};

  \node at (9.75,0) {$+$};

  \begin{scope}[xshift=10.9cm]
    \draw[fdl] (0,0.3) circle (0.3); \draw[fdl] (0,-0.3) circle (0.3);
    \draw[fdl] (1.4,0.3) circle (0.3); \draw[fdl] (1.4,-0.3) circle (0.3);
